name: Jar of Bees
description:
A glass jar filled with bees, kept perpetually alive and angry by magic. The Difficulty starts at 0.

When the jar is opened, the bees will fly in a straight line out of the top of the jar until they meet a creature, which they will swarm. If the jar is broken, the bees will swarm the nearest creature.

When the bees swarm a creature, it takes 1d4 damage, checks a Condition, and must roll Fortitude against the Difficulty. On a pass, the bees relent. On a failure, repeat this effect at the start of the creature's next turn.

A creature holding the bees' jar may attempt to call them back to it, rolling Persuade against the Difficulty. On a pass, the bees return to the jar and the Difficulty increases by 2. On a failure, the bees swarm the creature holding the jar as above, then fly away.
